title: Designing Agentic Workflows: Patterns and Tradeoffs
description:
Agentic workflows combine APIs, AI reasoning, and human decisions across systems—introducing new challenges in orchestration, reliability, and observability at scale. In this table talk, we’ll explore how teams are designing agentic business processes, comparing approaches to combining deterministic workflows and AI-driven decisioning. Join to discuss tradeoffs, real-world challenges, and lessons from moving a single workflow into production.

Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.
